description: Start a NEW Echosaw analysis job from a publicly accessible media URL or video platform URL (YouTube, Rumble, Vimeo, etc.). This is an entry point that creates a job and begins processing — it does not fetch previously analyzed media (use echosaw_download_media for that). Returns a job ID (mediaId) used to track processing and retrieve results.

mediaType.description: One of: video, audio, image, document (PDF, TXT, MD, PPTX)

url.description: HTTP(S) URL of the media file, or a video platform URL (e.g., YouTube, Rumble, Vimeo)

name: echosaw_analyze_media_url
